task.title: Add, Edit, or Delete Your Saved Autofill Info in Chrome
task.shortdesc: Add, edit, or delete saved autofill information—such as payment methods, addresses, and contact details—in Chrome.

context.note: If your payment method is saved in Google Wallet, you must edit or delete it in Google Wallet.

step.cmd: Select the info that you want to update.
step.stepxmp: For example, select payment methods, addresses, or contact info.

step.cmd: Turn Save and fill on or off under each category.

info.p: This allows you to turn autofill off completely.

step.cmd: To add, edit, or delete autofill information, follow the steps in the table:

chdesc.p: At the top right of the info type, select Add.
chdesc.note: Some menus have additional options and info types to choose from.

chdesc.p: To the right of the saved info, select MoreEdit or MoreDelete.

result.p: If you add, edit, or delete info and you're signed in to Chrome with your Google Account, your changes will also show up on your other devices where you're signed in to Chrome with the same account.
